displayDescription: Hand-drawn stop-motion: a taped paper idea card branches into three pencil boxes that link into a system on blue-grey graph paper.
motionEngine: GSAP paused timeline (window.__timelines.video) as sole time owner; render(t) samples held drawings at 10 per second
limitations: Paper, graphite, tape and highlighter are procedural Canvas/Rough.js approximations, not photographed paper stop-motion
Line variation comes from three fixed-seed drawing variants per object, not true hand-redrawn frames
PixiJS was reviewed but not needed for this flat paper scene
Both heading lines are graphite ink, not terracotta, because terracotta on the scene paper is only about 3.2:1; terracotta is kept for the bulb and the underline

Handwriting uses an @font-face alias 'HandNote' that resolves to the local system fonts Chalkboard SE, then Comic Sans MS (src: local(); no font file is bundled), so glyphs can differ on machines without those fonts
